mapper.select: SELECT stock_code AS stockCode, sector FROM stock_info

SELECT si.stock_code AS stockCode, s.stock_name AS stockName, si.sector, sf.debt_ratio AS debtRatio, sf.interest_coverage AS interestCoverage, sf.current_ratio AS currentRatio, sf.roe, sf.operating_margin AS operatingMargin FROM stock_info si INNER JOIN stocks s ON si.stock_code = s.stock_code INNER JOIN stock_financials sf ON si.stock_code = sf.stock_code AND sf.period_code = '11011' AND sf.base_year = YEAR(NOW()) - 1 WHERE sf.debt_ratio IS NOT NULL
